notes.title: Patch Notes for December 7th Release
notes.notes:
This update allows users to play an optional Christmas mode, where there is a new music track added, snow, and seasonal pickups. It will be available through January 12th.

There are also various other minor patches & fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes for Thursday, November 17th 2022
notes.notes:
Some players discovered that the "Fully Loaded" Achievement Steam achievement did not activate properly after collecting all requirements. This should be resolved now.

Please let me know if you run into anything else.

Thank you!

notes.title: Stability Patch - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Today we are releasing a small bug fix for the Wrath of Anias.

The major bug that was fixed is the Lighthouse sometimes remained standing after beating the game. In addition, there are a few other performance fixes and bug fixes in this patch as well.

Please let us know if you notice anything!

Thank you,

notes.title: Wrath of Anias - Update Launched!
notes.notes:
Blue Ocean Software is pleased to announce an update for Wrath of Anias! We are listening and taking your feedback seriously. Please see below list of changes that should enhance the experience for the game. If you run into any issues, please don't hesitate to let us know so we can resolve them! Thank you for your support!

Change log:


 Implemented Full Ability to Save & Load Game
 Ability to Restart Game
 Ability to Change Graphic Settings (Lower Systems Can Now Run Game)
 Full Controller Support
 Ending Scenario Reworked
 Ability to Skip All Cutscenes
 Knife And Keys Show Up More Prominently
 Added Some Animations To Certain Actions
 Added Additional Collectibles and Gameplay Items
 Compressed Install Size by 77%
 Added Achievements
 Added Subtitles For All Dialogue
 Added Multiple Languages


Bugs Fixed:

 Using Computer In Cave Bugs Have Been Resolved
 Bugs Around Menus Resolved
 Bugs When Loading Last Checkpoint Resolved
 Forgotten Floating Item Removed
 Removed Painted Glass Effect

notes.title: Wrath Of Anias - Update/Patch Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work taking into consideration the feedback we've received at launch, and have quite a list of updates forthcoming.

Some of the items that will be available:

Save & Reload/Resume
Resolution & Graphic Selections
Ability to Skip All Cutscenes
Significant Performance Improvements
Improved Compression
Subtitles
Full Controller Support
Much, much more...


Thanks for everyone who's downloaded and played the Wrath of Anias, and for everyone who has provided valuable feedback!
